overall_assessment: Reviewed all 16 packet entries (13 fetched plans, including five suspects and eight random controls, plus three failed-fetch entries); the available plan text is readable and shows no confirmed extraction defect. All five year flags concern last-offered spring 2025 dates on current-plan pages and are false alarms under UiO's plan_years = current policy; uncaptured text consists of navigation, semester selectors, administrative stamps, resource links and explicitly excluded status banners, while the SVLEP3090 truncation marker is a packet display limit. The three failed entries have plausible course-specific URLs and only 'not fetched' as their error, so neither incorrect URLs nor an extraction failure can be established; the institution-wide availability of only 47 fetched pages among 10,488 offerings limits conclusions about overall harvest coverage.
